era: timeanddate.com as served through 2019 (Arquivo captures Jan, Jul and Dec 2019 of the home and World Clock pages; Wayback Jan, Jul and Dec 2019): white header with the coloured-arcs logo, a dark grey nav bar (Home, World Clock, Time Zones, Calendar, Weather, Sun & Moon, Timers, Calculators, Apps & API, Free Fun, account icon, search), a small grey sub-bar (Newsletter, About Us, Site Map, Account/Settings), blue #4d66a5 section headings with link lists, and a one-line footer (logo, copyright, About Us | Advertising | Disclaimer | Privacy | Sitemap).
